Package edu.odu.cs.cs350

Class SummaryProjection

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.SummaryProjection
public class SummaryProjection extends Object
Generates a summary projection report for courses. The report is printed to standard output. It consists of two header lines followed by a line for each course offered during the current semester. Header line 1: percentage of the enrollment period that has elapsed. Header line 2: column headings. Each course line includes: * a marker (`*` if projected enrollment > total cap, otherwise a space) * course name * current enrollment (summed over all offerings) * projected enrollment for the add deadline * total cap (summed over all offerings) Course snapshots are stored as dated CSV files within a semester directory.

    • loadCourses

      public static List<Course> loadCourses(Path csvFile) throws IOException
      Imports and aggregates a dated course snapshot. The CSV must contain SUBJ, CRSE, XLST CAP, and ENR columns. Each row is an offering; enrollment and capacity are summed by subject and course number. A single snapshot has no projection information, so projected enrollment is initialized to current enrollment.
      Parameters:
      csvFile - the dated course snapshot to import.
      Returns:
      courses sorted by their subject and course number.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read or required columns are absent.

    • extractUniqueCourseNames

      public static List<String> extractUniqueCourseNames(Path csvFile) throws IOException
      Extracts a sorted list of unique course identifiers from a CSV file. The CSV must contain a header row with columns named SUBJ (subject) and CRSE (course number). Each subsequent row represents a course offering. The method concatenates SUBJ and CRSE (e.g., CS115) for each row, deduplicates the results, and returns them in ascending order.
      Parameters:
      csvFile - the path to the CSV file containing course data.
      Returns:
      a sorted list of unique course names.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the file.
